title: 3 habits for a more focused day
hook: Three habits for a more focused day.

beats.narration: Three tiny habits for a far more focused day.
One: plan tomorrow tonight. Pick your top three tasks before bed.
Two: work in focus sprints, twenty five to fifty minutes, then rest.
Three: silence your phone and put it out of reach.
Stack all three, and your best hours go to what matters.
Save this and try one habit tomorrow.
